subject: Post-demo: procurement & vendor setup next steps (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@acme-analytics.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & vendor setup next steps (Acme Analytics)

Hi Samantha / Tom -

Thanks again for joining the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what it needs to onboard Redwood:

Recap:
- Goal: Replace in-house LLM endpoints for customer-facing search and support routing; target go-live Q2.
- Expected steady-state spend: $12k-18k / month initially, scaling with usage.
- Technical note: we support both hosted API and private deployment; team prefers hosted for now.

Procurement questions / asks:
1) Do you expect to pay via PO (net terms) or card? If PO, what are the standard terms (Net30/Net45)?
2) Do you require a vendor setup packet (W-9, banking details, insurance)? I can send our packet and standard contract redlines.
3) Are you interested in purchasing through AWS Marketplace or a direct vendor setup?

Next steps (proposed):
- I will send a vendor setup packet (W-9 + banking stub) and an initial SOW/quote by EOD Friday.
- Tom, if you can share the procurement contact or vendor portal link, we'll upload documentation there.
- Vivek and I will follow up on pricing cadence and provide a purchase order option if needed.

If you prefer, we can loop in procurement@acme-analytics.com and go through your vendor portal flow.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

Attachments: (I will attach the vendor setup packet and W-9 in a follow-up)

From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & vendor setup next steps (Acme Analytics)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and the demo — team liked the latency profile. A few quick items from procurement:

- Payment method: We prefer PO for vendor relationships at this stage (Net30). Occasionally we do corporate card for < $5k purchases.
- Vendor setup packet: yes, please send the full packet (W-9 or W-8, banking wiring info, OTC contact, certificate of insurance if available).
- Marketplace: We prefer Marketplace purchases when available (for billing and internal approvals), but we can do direct vendor setup for strategic partners.

Questions:
1) Can Redwood accept Net30 PO terms?
2) Do you have a documentation-ready vendor packet we can drop into our portal? If so, please upload or send as attachments.
3) Who is the contract signatory for Redwood (name/title)? We need that for our contract routing.

I can start the vendor intake once I have the packet and signatory info. If we go Marketplace later, procurement will still want the vendor record on file.

Thanks — I'll route this to procurement and follow up with the portal link.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement | Acme Analytics
s.lee@acme-analytics.com
procurement@acme-analytics.com

Thanks Samantha - attaching our standard vendor setup packet and W-9 (PDF stubs).

Quick answers inline:
- PO terms: We can accept Net30 on PO for this account. We typically require a signed MSA for > $50k ARR but for initial spend we can start on PO + initial SOW.
- Packet: attached: vendor_setup_packet.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf, redwood_banking_stub.txt (banking details stub for portal upload). Let me know if you need a certificate of insurance and I'll pull that.
- Signatory:
  Name: Priya Natarajan
  Title: VP, Revenue Operations
  Email: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa (me): Send packet (attached) and initial quote + SOW by Monday 3/2.
- Samantha / Procurement: Confirm vendor portal link and any additional fields required for onboarding.
- Vivek: Standby for pricing questions and to join procurement call if needed.

We can also set up a short vendor intake call (15 min) next week if that helps speed the portal upload.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: vendor_setup_packet.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf, redwood_banking_stub.txt

Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & vendor setup next steps (Acme Analytics)

Hi Marissa -

Received the packet, thanks. Portal link here: https://vendors.acme-analytics.com/onboard/ACME-REDWOOD-987

A couple notes from the intake form:
- Please upload the W-9 and banking stub to the portal (we matched the filenames to your attachment names).
- Contract signatory: we will accept the VP, Revenue Operations as listed.
- Insurance: for now we only require general liability; if you can supply a COI we'll attach to the vendor record — otherwise we can proceed and request later.
- PO process: We will issue a PO once vendor onboarding is complete and we have the SOW. Expected timeline: vendor setup (2-5 business days) + PO issuance (3-7 business days).

PO number will be emailed to the address on file and included on the invoice. If you need the PO earlier for procurement exceptions, please let us know and we can escalate.

Thanks - looking forward to the SOW.

procurement@acme-analytics.com
Vendor Intake Team
Acme Analytics
